title: silaalak addat tan kas xongolo
intro: dumaahi wargih muuci, adda xeerih yan mablal yamixxige, bool karmoomih addat kollih yaaba. Ta num nabiyyi qigdu mafaxinna, uxih qibaadah wale ken qangoorut caxta. Amotani miraaciino cabteh tan xaleenah, ken fayitte milyoonul loowimta maritteh sorkocô baxat daccarsimteeh, asaaku fan qimmol elle qimmisseh sugte.
clues: Anu yoo baxisse qibaadah acwa hirgeh- wale kaxxam addah tan aydaadul yok baxxaqsa le caalat tekke.
Anu farmoytak masugiyyo hinnay malayka hinniyo- dubuk rooci barkat le cedu kee baadal cedu.
Yok xayi angaaraw yi baxa lih sugeeh, ta angaarawih addat, yok kaxxam sarrimaane le farmo gufte.
Anu kullim yoh yeceeh yan numuh gadda gacsaanam essereeh, kaxxiinaa kee kaxxiinitak takkaawisa.
Anu barseh qilsa wagittam walaa bisbaasa dariyyih melleb abtoota, kee tuxxiiqi inki xongolo salcisaanam rammitle.
Qur'aanak inki mafdaga yi migaq leeh, yi kacnoytih baxah ecee fayitte amotani daccarsimte.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
